summary: The red box's criteria are mostly encoded with sound SNOMED concepts, but the Urgent rule drops the exertional SpO2 < 87% criterion and the one-tablespoon haemoptysis volume, and the PJP rule omits CD4 < 200 so it over-calls probable PJP. COPD probable lacks the 3-months-most-days pattern, and tight chest is both Urgent and a bronchitis cue. Severe pneumonia (2-of-4) and the shock footnote definition are not encoded.
